summary: The test disproves the claim: availableLiquidityForPendingBatch subtracts the normalized amount still owed to older unpaid batches, so a newer batch is paid only from assets in excess of what the older batch needs (nothing when the repayment is smaller than the older debt, only the excess otherwise), and a 1000-run fuzz shows the older batch always ends up paid min(owed, available) with the idle assets reserved for it; the report's cited line WildcatMarketWithdrawals.sol#L153 is only the queueFullWithdrawal doc comment.
